scope: Dedicated server mechanics using actual game objects and packet-stub players; not actual connections or GUI checks.
limitations: No real connected clients or GUI clicks in this mechanics fixture.
Native/fallback capability decisions are set on packet-stub players; network negotiation is covered separately.
Three Defaulted-specific dynamic-prototype cases are skipped because the library is absent.
Enchantment-upgrade/pinnacle crafting and unrelated full server stack combinations are not verified by these cases.
Pouch Mending and stack movement are separate QA fixtures; not duplicated here.
